note: Northwind Mutual is an invented insurer. Every clause id, amount and rule below was written for this demo and belongs to no real policy. Load a different pack and the same tools answer with that insurer's schedule instead.

coverages.label: Theft and attempted theft
coverages.inactive_reason: The theft and attempted theft rider was quoted at renewal but was not added to this policy, so a stolen vehicle is not covered.

excluded_drivers.name: Nikos P.
excluded_drivers.reason: Nikos P. is listed as an excluded driver on this policy, so any incident while he is at the wheel falls outside cover.

requirements.label: The date the incident happened
requirements.why: Clause FN-1.1 asks for the date of loss on every first notice, because the date decides whether the policy was in force.

requirements.label: Your own account of what happened
requirements.why: Clause FN-1.3 asks the claimant to describe the incident in their own words before a handler reads the file.

requirements.label: Where on the car the impact landed
requirements.why: Clause OD-4.1 settles damage panel by panel, so the impact position decides which panels are in scope.

requirements.label: How heavy the damage is
requirements.why: Clause OD-4.4 routes a structural job to a body shop on the insurer list and a light job to any repairer.

requirements.label: Whether the car can still be driven
requirements.why: Clause RA-3.1 makes the drivable answer the switch between a booked repair and a recovery.

requirements.label: The police report reference
requirements.why: Clause PR-6.2 asks for a police report reference when the shell is out of true or the vehicle was taken.

requirements.label: Roadside collection for a car that cannot be driven
requirements.why: Clause RA-3.2 covers collection of a vehicle that cannot be driven, and this policy will not book a repair slot until the collection is arranged.

satisfied_by.human_action: a person presses Request roadside assistance on this page. There is no tool for it, so an agent has to ask the claimant to do it.

requirements.label: Where the car is now, so it can be collected
requirements.why: Clause RA-3.2 sends a recovery truck to the vehicle, and a truck needs somewhere to go.
